title: A surface chemistry perspective on SERS: revisiting the basics to push the field forward
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,5224-5247
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01242A, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chiara Deriu, Laura Fabris
Surface chemistry is a critical, yet underdeveloped topic in SERS. The surface landscape and associated thermodynamic equilibria of the most common SERS colloids are here reviewed to provide key, centralized information to push the technique forward.
